text:
Football seasons can pivot on certain moments and Thomas Frank will hope that Crystal Palace’s came 17 minutes from time here. Deservedly trailing to Mamadou Sarr’s goal having been second best throughout against Real Sociedad, this game and perhaps the south London club’s entire trajectory was turned on its head after Jon Martin was sent off for denying Jean-Philippe Mateta an equaliser.
The France striker made no mistake with his penalty before Dwight McNeil capped an extraordinary comeback in Frank’s first home match since succeeding Pierre Sage. Suddenly Palace have hope where there appeared to be none. The Premier League’s bottom side will head into Sunday’s crucial showdown with Hull with a spring in their step despite Yéremy Pino’s missed penalty in injury time after the outstanding Dean Henderson pulled off a stunning late save to seal the victory.
Frank had urged the Palace supporters ensure the atmosphere was “through the roof” for his home debut and he immediately made a beeline for the Holmesdale Road End after emerging from the tunnel. Almost all of his squad – including the two substitute goalkeepers – had spent a substantial part of the warm-up practising defending set pieces so there was no doubt where the priorities lay. But the Palace manager didn’t look amused when Mamadou Sarr was inches away from connecting with a free-kick in the second minute as the visitors served warning of the threat they posed.
Sociedad have struggled in this competition despite a promising start to their La Liga campaign and it was a surprise to see Pellegrino Matarazzo match Frank’s 4-4-2 formation in what felt like something of a throwback to the mid 1990s. With Adam Wharton suspended after his red card against Hoffenheim, Palace found it very difficult to escape their press as Mateta and Eddie Nketiah were forced to feed off whatever scraps that came their way.
Ben Chilwell looked unsettled by the pace of Héctor Fort, the former Barcelona right-back, and Sociedad began to target the former England defender’s left flank. Mikel Oyarzabal should have done much better when he was picked out by the lively Arsen Zakharyan.
Not for the first time, Palace had Henderson to thank for keeping the scores level when Zakharyan was given far too much time and space by Chilwell. The Russian picked out Goncalo Guedes and his shot was parried away to safety. The former Wolves forward tried his luck again soon after and once more Henderson was equal to his effort. The Palace captain could not hide his emotions as he rightly questioned why their opponents were being afforded so much space. Mateta had to wait until the final minute of the first half for a sighter and the France striker could only nod over from a long Chris Richards throw.
Henderson was called into action twice inside the opening six minutes of the second half as Sociedad smelled blood. Oyarzabal should have rounded off a lightning-quick break downfield but could only shoot straight at the England goalkeeper before Jon Gorrotxategi was denied from the edge of the area. With his side struggling to gain a foothold, Frank abandoned his experiment with Nketiah and brought on Dwight McNeil to try to give Chilwell a helping hand. To their credit, Palace’s response was immediate. Disasi won a header from another long throw and Martin hauled down Mateta as he was about to score, earning a second yellow card. Mateta dispatched the spot kick with aplomb and only a desperate goalline clearance from Sarr denied Kamada. Frank went for broke by throwing on Jorgen Strand Larsen and his gamble paid off when the Norway striker’s attempted overhead kick presented McNeil with the easiest of opportunities to lift the gloom in these parts.
digest_he: תומאס פרנק השלים מהפך דרמטי והושג ניצחון הבכורה שלו כמאמן קריסטל פאלאס, עם 1-2 על ריאל סוסיאדד במסגרת הליגה האירופית. המארחת נקלעה לפיגור בדקה ה-66 משער של ממדו סאר לאחר שליטה אורחת ממושכת וסדרת הצלות של השוער דין הנדרסון. המפנה הגיע כאשר ג'ון מרטין הורחק בכרטיס צהוב שני לאחר שעצר את ז'אן-פיליפ מטטה ברחבה. החלוץ הצרפתי דייק בפנדל והשווה את התוצאה בדקה ה-73. דווייט מקניל הבקיע את שער הניצחון בדקה ה-82 לאחר ניסיון מספרת של יורגן סטראנד לארסן, והעניק לקריסטל פאלאס שלוש נקודות יקרות לקראת ההתמודדות הבאה בליגה מול האל.
